description: Human-curated set of legitimately-independent duplicate own-definitions. A symbol name + file matching an entry here is tagged ALLOWLISTED in duplicate-symbols.md instead of TRUE_DUPLICATE, and check-duplicates.mjs never fails on it. Patterns: a trailing '*' on a name is a prefix match, literal '*' matches any name; a trailing '/**' on a file glob is a directory-prefix match, anything else is an exact path.

entries.reason: Worker bundle is built standalone to dist/workers/ and loaded by file path at runtime (see tsup.config.ts); it deliberately keeps local copies rather than importing across the worker bundle boundary.
